title: Fixes #8869: French sales reports must ignore comment lines when evaluating GetGoodsAndServicesText
summary: In the French localization, the Standard Sales Invoice, Draft Invoice and Credit Memo reports now filter out comment lines when GetGoodsAndServicesText decides whether the document covers goods or services.
key_points: Comment lines are filtered out when GetGoodsAndServicesText is evaluated
Previously, comment lines were counted as services on printed documents
Affects the FR Standard Sales Invoice, Draft Invoice and Credit Memo reports
